summary: Build a public personal journaling/story site where only the owner can create daily posts (text + photo/video), with some posts free and others paywalled; users must log in with Internet Identity to view locked posts, with a view toward future monetization and added health-progress tracking.
architectural_notes: Single-author system: only the site owner can create/manage posts; public users are readers only.
Access control model: posts have free vs locked visibility; locked content requires Internet Identity login to view.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimalist wordmark logo in warm charcoal and cream palette (logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Subtle paper-grain background texture, light warm tone (paper-texture.dim_1600x900.png)

existing_features.title: Add an owner-only authoring/admin workflow so only the site owner can create and manage posts.
Gate locked posts behind Internet Identity login: users can browse free content publicly, but must sign in with Internet Identity to view locked post content.

Implement a minimal paywall entitlement mechanism for locked posts (without integrating payments): after Internet Identity login, only principals that are explicitly allowed can view locked content; the owner can grant/revoke access.
Support media attachments on posts in the initial version: allow adding images and videos to a post, and display them in post detail views.
Create public-facing pages for browsing and reading posts: a home/feed page, a post detail page, and basic navigation.
Add a coherent visual theme and typography system for the journal app and apply it consistently across pages.
Add basic content safety/quality constraints and empty/loading states throughout the UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create daily public posts (single author) with text content and basic post listing/detail views
Support media attachments on posts (photo and video upload/embedding) in the initial version
Paywall individual posts: mark posts as free vs locked and restrict locked content
Internet Identity authentication required only to view paywalled (locked) posts
Owner-only authoring/admin workflow so only the site owner can create and manage posts
Implement backend data model and APIs for a single-author journal with posts that can be marked as free or locked, including create/update/delete and public read access.

projectName: Public journal/story site with single-author posting, media attachments, and II-gated locked posts
